common.appDescription: Describe a business, generate six pages with AI, then edit every word and image visually.

meta.title: Website Studio — from a short brief to a finished website
meta.description: Describe a business, let AI write six pages, then edit every word and image in a live visual editor.

hero.body: Website Studio is the AI studio for small businesses that need a considered web presence. Answer four steps and get six pages — then shape them in one calm editor.
hero.meta: Four steps · Six pages · No code

preview.sampleTagline: A calm architectural practice in Zurich.

website.title: A complete website
website.body: Six pages written from one brief, in a single consistent voice.

editor.title: A real visual editor
editor.body: Edit the generated page itself — type, images, links and lists.

static.title: Static by default
static.body: Fast HTML output with no runtime to maintain and no page builder.

steps.body: There is no page builder to learn. The brief is the starting point, the AI draft is the first version, and the editor is where it becomes the business's own.

brief.title: Write the brief
brief.body: Name the business, describe what it does, and add the services worth showing. Only the first three answers are required.

pages.title: AI drafts six pages
pages.body: Home, studio, services, work, profile and contact — written from the facts you supplied. No invented awards, clients or history.

shape.title: Shape it visually
shape.body: Click any headline, paragraph, image or link in the live preview. The page you edit is the page the website serves.

share.title: Share the result
share.body: Save once and the static site is rebuilt. Every site gets its own preview link, ready to send to the business.

quote.line1: A website shouldn't feel like a form you filled in.
quote.line2: It should feel like the business itself.
quote.body: One profile feeds every page, so the site reads like one brand from home to contact.

features.intro: A complete website studio, reduced to the few things that matter: the brief, the draft, and the editor. The rest stays out of your way.

write.body: Brief it once. The draft follows the business, its audience and its tone — then needs a light touch, not a rewrite.
write.mockTitle: Spaces made for long, quiet afternoons.
write.mockBody: Northline Studio designs calm residential architecture for people who would rather live slowly.

ground.body: Blank fields stay blank. Every award, client and claim on the website comes from the brief.

complete.body: The same business profile feeds every page, so nothing reads like an afterthought.

shape.body: Open any page, switch between edit and preview, and check the result exactly as a visitor would see it.

principle.quote: “The business already knows what it is. The website should catch up.”

cta.body: Open the dashboard, answer four steps, and let the first draft do the heavy lifting.
cta.note: No code. No page builder. Everything editable.
cta.tagline: AI website studio / six pages per brief

siteCreation.title: Start with the brief.
siteCreation.intro: Four steps. Only the first three fields are required; everything else sharpens the copy.

basics.description: Name, industry, and what the business does.

offer.title: Offer
offer.description: Services, audience, and tone of voice.

details.title: Details
details.description: Contact, track record, and optional extras.

review.title: Review

basics.title: Tell us about the business
basics.description: These three answers are all the AI needs to start.

offer.title: What should the site sell?
offer.description: Optional, but specific services and a clear audience make stronger copy.

details.title: Add the details that matter
details.description: Only include facts you can stand behind. Blank fields are never invented.

review.title: Review the brief
review.description: One last look before AI writes all six pages.

placeholders.description: Describe the business, what it offers, and what makes it different.
placeholders.services: One service per line. Leave blank to let the AI infer from the description.
placeholders.awards: One per line, for example: 2023 - Swiss Architecture Prize
placeholders.notableClients: One per line. Only add names you have permission to publish.
placeholders.extraDetails: Founding story, philosophy, notable projects, or other facts to use.

review.note: AI writes six pages from this brief: home, studio, services, work, profile, and contact. You can edit everything afterwards.
